meta.reviewMethod: Contact sheets (4x4 thumbnails, EXIF-corrected) reviewed 2026-10-15; entries marked review=full were additionally opened at full resolution.

matchLegend.match: observed content agrees with the PDF caption for that filename
matchLegend.mismatch: observed content differs from the PDF caption (see NV-007)
matchLegend.caption-missing: the PDF gallery has no content line for this file
matchLegend.unclear: thumbnail too small to confirm title/content

meta.excludedFiles: Seven loose WhatsApp images in C:/Users/Pc/Videos/avis (2026-09-20 / 2026-09-22) were reviewed and excluded: they show ceiling lamps, a door chime and personal identity documents - not plant content, and not copied into this project.
